verses.1: From their deceitful ears, they cause harm to the LORD; they desire a “perfect stone” from which no harm can come.
verses.2: In that time, Caloan came along, along with his wise men.
verses.3: May the righteous be comforted, and may those who speak lies be punished.
verses.4: Do not use it on the day of crossing over; righteousness will save from death.
verses.5: In the righteous, justice will be upheld; in his sin, the wicked will fall.
verses.6: The righteousness of the righteous will save them, but in times of wickedness, they will be destroyed.
verses.7: In the death of an evil person, his prayers are destroyed, and his wealth is lost.
verses.8: The righteous was rescued from suffering, while the wicked came under his rule.
verses.9: With an open mouth, he will slander his enemies; but in the knowledge of the righteous, they will be protected.
verses.10: In the good, the righteous will be rewarded; in the evil, the wicked will be punished.
verses.11: In the blessings of the righteous, there is abundance; but in the mouth of the wicked, there is destruction.
verses.12: He is heartless and a man who hates to help others.
verses.13: He walks with a hungry heart, and his words are filled with truth.
verses.14: Without troubles, a people will not fall; and salvation will be abundant.
verses.15: Evil is like a foreign land; it’s full of chaos and disorder. People try to establish their own rules there.
verses.16: Grace will fill them with honor, and those who are arrogant will be brought down.
verses.17: He has a kind heart, but his actions are cruel and unjust.
verses.18: The wicked do evil deeds that are false; they are the offspring of righteousness, yet they receive no reward.
verses.19: So, it’s justifiable to live, and it’s wrong to pursue evil for the sake of death.
verses.20: The LORD’s displeasure is for those who are stubborn of heart, but He desires those who walk in righteousness.
verses.21: Hand to hand, no harm shall be done; the seeds of righteousness will be sown.
verses.22: A golden ring in the ear of a beautiful woman. It has a delicious taste.
verses.23: The prayers of the righteous are good; but the prayers of the wicked are evil.
verses.24: There is still confusion and addition going on, and it’s difficult to understand what’s really happening.
verses.25: The soul that is blessed will also be filled with joy.
verses.26: May it be a blessing for the eyes and a blessing for the head of those who are broken.
verses.27: A good person seeks what is good, while a bad person seeks what is evil.
verses.28: In his old age, he will fall; but the righteous will flourish.
verses.29: May his house be filled with peace and tranquility, and may the servant of the fox be wise.
verses.30: A tree of life and a source of wise souls.
verses.31: Even a righteous person will be blessed in this world, even if they are wicked and evil.
